trans-unit.id: Air pollution output is divided by this to determine PPM. It depends on AtmospherePressureKgPerM2 and the world area. For 1km2 and pressure 1kg/m2, 1 ton = 1PPM (part per million), which is the unit that determines climate change effects.
trans-unit.source: Air pollution output is divided by this to determine PPM. It depends on AtmospherePressureKgPerM2 and the world area. For 1km2 and pressure 1kg/m2, 1 ton = 1PPM (part per million), which is the unit that determines climate change effects.
trans-unit.target: Výstup znečištění ovzduší se tímto číslem dělí, aby vzniklo PPM. Závisí na AtmospherePressureKgPerM2 a rozloze světa. Pro 1 km² a tlak 1 kg/m² platí, že 1 tuna = 1 PPM (díl na milion), což je jednotka určující dopady klimatické změny.

trans-unit.id: How much PPM (particles per million) will be added to/removed from atmosphere per one tone of matter (i.e. CO2).
trans-unit.source: How much PPM (particles per million) will be added to/removed from atmosphere per one tone of matter (i.e. CO2).
trans-unit.target: Kolik PPM (dílů na milion) se do atmosféry přidá nebo z ní odebere na jednu tunu látky (např. CO2).

trans-unit.id: Atmosphere pressure used in the atmosphere size formula. Trees absorb and pollution from tables produced in tons and converted to PPM by dividing on total atmosphere size. AtmosphereSizeInTons = WorldAreaInM2 * AtmospherePressureKgPerM2 where WorldAreaInM2 = (Dimensions.x * 10) * (Dimensions.y * 10). In example for 1km² (1000000m²) world with atmosphere pressure 1 kg/m² it will be 1000000 tons, resulting in 1 PPM per 1 ton of pollution or absorb (1 PPM = 1000000 * tons / AtmosphereSizeInTons), increasing pressure to 2 will result in 0.5 PPM per ton.
trans-unit.source: Atmosphere pressure used in the atmosphere size formula. Trees absorb and pollution from tables produced in tons and converted to PPM by dividing on total atmosphere size. AtmosphereSizeInTons = WorldAreaInM2 * AtmospherePressureKgPerM2 where WorldAreaInM2 = (Dimensions.x * 10) * (Dimensions.y * 10). In example for 1km² (1000000m²) world with atmosphere pressure 1 kg/m² it will be 1000000 tons, resulting in 1 PPM per 1 ton of pollution or absorb (1 PPM = 1000000 * tons / AtmosphereSizeInTons), increasing pressure to 2 will result in 0.5 PPM per ton.
trans-unit.target: Atmosférický tlak použitý ve vzorci pro velikost atmosféry. Stromy CO2 pohlcují a znečištění ze stolů vzniká v tunách; na PPM se přepočítává vydělením celkovou velikostí atmosféry. AtmosphereSizeInTons = WorldAreaInM2 * AtmospherePressureKgPerM2, kde WorldAreaInM2 = (Dimensions.x * 10) * (Dimensions.y * 10). Například pro svět o rozloze 1 km² (1 000 000 m²) s atmosférickým tlakem 1 kg/m² to bude 1 000 000 tun, což dává 1 PPM na 1 tunu znečištění nebo pohlcení (1 PPM = 1000000 * tuny / AtmosphereSizeInTons); zvýšením tlaku na 2 se hodnota sníží na 0,5 PPM na tunu.

trans-unit.source: Your GPU's Max Tessellation Level is less than 64. AMD is the only known GPU manufacturer who doesn't follow the standard and reduces this setting to hack performance in their "AMD Radeon Software", setting it to 8 in the default optimized settings. You may experience problems with the Minimap rendering. To fix this, set "Max Tessellation Level" to 64 in the software for Eco (explicitly) and restart the game.
trans-unit.target: Maximální úroveň teselace tvé grafické karty je nižší než 64. AMD je jediný známý výrobce grafických karet, který nedodržuje standard a ve svém softwaru „AMD Radeon Software“ toto nastavení kvůli výkonu snižuje – ve výchozím optimalizovaném nastavení na 8. Může docházet k problémům s vykreslováním minimapy. Řešení: v softwaru grafické karty nastav pro Eco (výslovně) „Maximální úroveň teselace“ (v angličtině „Max Tessellation Level“) na 64 a restartuj hru.

trans-unit.id: This setting defines how plants will be grouped when the world generates. It have two levels of grouping: clusters and groups. A cluster is a large area of the world where a particular type of plant exists, and it affects gameplay by limiting where specific plants can be spawned. Groups are primarily for visual purposes, so plants of the same species grow together with only a small distance between them.
trans-unit.source: This setting defines how plants will be grouped when the world generates. It have two levels of grouping: clusters and groups. A cluster is a large area of the world where a particular type of plant exists, and it affects gameplay by limiting where specific plants can be spawned. Groups are primarily for visual purposes, so plants of the same species grow together with only a small distance between them.
trans-unit.target: Toto nastavení určuje, jak se rostliny při generování světa seskupují. Seskupování má dvě úrovně: shluky a skupiny. Shluk je velká oblast světa, kde se určitý druh rostliny vyskytuje, a ovlivňuje hratelnost tím, že omezuje, kde se konkrétní rostliny mohou vygenerovat. Skupiny slouží hlavně vizuálním účelům: rostliny stejného druhu rostou pohromadě, jen s malými rozestupy.

trans-unit.source: If set, we don't care where citizens bought any items, we allow all of them to be used here.
trans-unit.target: Pokud je zapnuto, nezáleží na tom, kde občané předměty koupili — všechny se zde smějí používat.

trans-unit.id: If the above option is not enabled and this world doesn't accept all items, this list can contain the IDs of worlds and the IDs of owners of worlds from which this server will allow items. This allows specifying servers together in a network of shared item usage.
trans-unit.source: If the above option is not enabled and this world doesn't accept all items, this list can contain the IDs of worlds and the IDs of owners of worlds from which this server will allow items. This allows specifying servers together in a network of shared item usage.
trans-unit.target: Pokud není předchozí možnost zapnutá a tento svět nepřijímá všechny předměty, může tento seznam obsahovat ID světů a ID majitelů světů, ze kterých tento server předměty povolí. Takto lze propojit servery do sítě se sdíleným používáním předmětů.

trans-unit.id: If set, we don't care where citizens got an achievement, we allow all of them to be used displayed and used here.
trans-unit.source: If set, we don't care where citizens got an achievement, we allow all of them to be used displayed and used here.

trans-unit.id: Shows a report of how neighboring settlements may impact a homestead that is placed at the citizen's current location.
trans-unit.source: Shows a report of how neighboring settlements may impact a homestead that is placed at the citizen's current location.
trans-unit.target: Zobrazí zprávu o tom, jak mohou sousední osady ovlivnit usedlost umístěnou na aktuální pozici občana.

trans-unit.id: Shows a report of how neighboring settlements may impact a settlement that is placed at the citizen's current location. Pass a number to specify settlement type that would be placed (0 = town, 1 = country, etc)
trans-unit.source: Shows a report of how neighboring settlements may impact a settlement that is placed at the citizen's current location. Pass a number to specify settlement type that would be placed (0 = town, 1 = country, etc)

trans-unit.id: Enables or disables a settlement. This will stop it from casting influence or applying laws when disabled.
trans-unit.source: Enables or disables a settlement. This will stop it from casting influence or applying laws when disabled.

trans-unit.source: Settlement Min Required Plot Coverage Percentage

trans-unit.source: Homestead Min Required Plot Coverage Percentage

trans-unit.source: A country/federation's influence must overlap a child town/country by this percentage in order to be a child.

trans-unit.source: Maps reputation of the artwork to culture points.

trans-unit.source: Gives reputation from the given user (defaulting to self if not set) to the given target (picture or user) ignoring limits by default.

trans-unit.source: When this is toggled, only unaffiliated homesteads (not a member of any settlement) will be allowed to expand into our settlement influence.

trans-unit.source: The founding of a Settlement will create an influence area that can be observed on the map. The chosen color will signify the extent of influence generated by this Settlement.

trans-unit.source: Any deed that is overburdened (too many plots claimed, not enough claim papers) will have plots unclaimed immediately (instead of waiting for timer)

trans-unit.source: This setting will help match you to a world where Citizens play similar lengths of time, so you progress at similar rates.
trans-unit.target: Toto nastavení ti pomůže najít svět, kde občané hrají podobně dlouho, takže budeš postupovat podobným tempem jako ostatní.

trans-unit.id: If unchecked, the default world will be used. Note: if world size is adjusted from normal, the world will always generate randomly.
trans-unit.source: If unchecked, the default world will be used. Note: if world size is adjusted from normal, the world will always generate randomly.

trans-unit.id: Determines how fast the game progresses, with 30 days being the normal progression. When set faster, the meteor will hit sooner but you will gain skill faster and crafting will take less time.
trans-unit.source: Determines how fast the game progresses, with 30 days being the normal progression. When set faster, the meteor will hit sooner but you will gain skill faster and crafting will take less time.
trans-unit.target: Určuje, jak rychle hra postupuje; 30 dní je běžný postup. Při rychlejším nastavení meteor dopadne dříve, ale dovednosti budeš získávat rychleji a výroba bude trvat méně času.

trans-unit.id: When set, citizens will become exhausted after the given number of hours. While exhausted, they cannot spend calories, but can still do other activities like making culture, etc. This setting is used to prevent some players from getting ahead of everyone else by playing many more hours than everyone else.
trans-unit.source: When set, citizens will become exhausted after the given number of hours. While exhausted, they cannot spend calories, but can still do other activities like making culture, etc. This setting is used to prevent some players from getting ahead of everyone else by playing many more hours than everyone else.
trans-unit.target: Je-li nastaveno, občané se po uplynutí daného počtu hodin vyčerpají. Vyčerpaní občané nemohou utrácet kalorie, ale stále mohou dělat jiné věci, například vytvářet kulturu. Toto nastavení brání tomu, aby někteří hráči získali náskok tím, že hrají mnohem víc hodin než ostatní.

trans-unit.id: Expected number of players that will be contributing towards the meteor. Adjusting this will change the number of specialties each person can take (depending on collaboration level).
trans-unit.source: Expected number of players that will be contributing towards the meteor. Adjusting this will change the number of specialties each person can take (depending on collaboration level).
trans-unit.target: Očekávaný počet hráčů, kteří se budou podílet na řešení meteoru. Změna tohoto čísla změní počet specializací, které si může každý vybrat (podle úrovně spolupráce).

trans-unit.id: How much collaboration citizens are expected to take part in. High collaboration means everyone will be highly reliant on the society functioning properly. No collaboration means no dependence is required, but you can still trade.
trans-unit.source: How much collaboration citizens are expected to take part in. High collaboration means everyone will be highly reliant on the society functioning properly. No collaboration means no dependence is required, but you can still trade.
trans-unit.target: Do jaké míry se od občanů očekává spolupráce. Vysoká spolupráce znamená, že všichni budou velmi závislí na správném fungování společnosti. Žádná spolupráce znamená, že žádná závislost není potřeba, ale stále můžeš obchodovat.

trans-unit.id: How strictly do you want to simulate logisitics like transport, inventory carry size, etc. Higher settings will make transport more important (you will need vehicles to move large quantities) and lower settings will allow individuals to carry large amounts, removing need for vehicles.
trans-unit.source: How strictly do you want to simulate logisitics like transport, inventory carry size, etc. Higher settings will make transport more important (you will need vehicles to move large quantities) and lower settings will allow individuals to carry large amounts, removing need for vehicles.
trans-unit.target: Jak přísně chceš simulovat logistiku, například dopravu, nosnost inventáře apod. Vyšší nastavení zvýší význam dopravy (k přepravě velkých množství budeš potřebovat vozidla), nižší nastavení umožní jednotlivcům unést velká množství, takže vozidla nebudou potřeba.

trans-unit.id: You can drag items directly from storages to create offer. Also drag on top of offer will update values from items like color of paint buckets.
trans-unit.source: You can drag items directly from storages to create offer. Also drag on top of offer will update values from items like color of paint buckets.

trans-unit.id: A distinctly different approach to mining, light the fuse and stand back!\n\n(Explosives convert blocks into their crushed variants.)
trans-unit.source: A distinctly different approach to mining, light the fuse and stand back!\n\n(Explosives convert blocks into their crushed variants.)
trans-unit.target: Zcela odlišný přístup k těžbě: zapal doutnák a ustup!\n\n(Výbušniny přeměňují bloky na jejich drcené varianty.)

trans-unit.id: A distinctly different approach to mining, now with the comforts and safety of a remote!\n\n(Explosives convert blocks into their crushed variants.)
trans-unit.source: A distinctly different approach to mining, now with the comforts and safety of a remote!\n\n(Explosives convert blocks into their crushed variants.)
trans-unit.target: Zcela odlišný přístup k těžbě, nyní s pohodlím a bezpečím dálkového ovládání!\n\n(Výbušniny přeměňují bloky na jejich drcené varianty.)

trans-unit.id: A remote that is linked to Mining Charges for detonation in a safe distance.
trans-unit.source: A remote that is linked to Mining Charges for detonation in a safe distance.
trans-unit.target: Dálkový ovladač propojený s důlními náložemi pro odpálení z bezpečné vzdálenosti.

trans-unit.id: Sulfur rocks that have been crushed into a fine gravel.
trans-unit.source: Sulfur rocks that have been crushed into a fine gravel.
trans-unit.target: Sírové horniny rozdrcené na jemný štěrk.

trans-unit.id: An unexpected surprise of peace and quiet in the rush for survival..
trans-unit.source: An unexpected surprise of peace and quiet in the rush for survival..

trans-unit.target: Hořlavý organický materiál, který lze použít jako palivo.

trans-unit.id: While it may not look like much it is fundamentally essential to sustain life.
trans-unit.source: While it may not look like much it is fundamentally essential to sustain life.
trans-unit.target: I když na první pohled nevypadá na nic moc, je naprosto zásadní pro udržení života.

trans-unit.id: The serenity and beauty of nature just outside in your own hands..

trans-unit.target: Kyselá sloučenina používaná v celé řadě chemických výrobků. Nevhodná pro potraviny.

trans-unit.id: Embrace the power of the people with this bold t-shirt. Crafted for the champions of equality, this shirt is a rallying cry for collective action. Wear it to stand united with your comrades in the fight for a fairer world!

trans-unit.id: A symbol of wealth and status, this lavish top hat is the crown jewel of the capitalist elite. trans-unit.id: How old records can be grouped. It means it will try to process all last X days of records to group them. Usually you want to have this number low (1-2) in order to avoid process already processed records, but you can set high value (by example world age) in order to process at once all records from some old save with disabled grouping.
trans-unit.source: How old records can be grouped. It means it will try to process all last X days of records to group them. Usually you want to have this number low (1-2) in order to avoid process already processed records, but you can set high value (by example world age) in order to process at once all records from some old save with disabled grouping.
trans-unit.target: Jak staré záznamy lze seskupovat. Znamená to, že se server pokusí seskupit všechny záznamy za posledních X dní. Obvykle se hodí nízké číslo (1–2), aby se znovu nezpracovávaly už zpracované záznamy; vysokou hodnotu (například stáří světa) můžeš nastavit, aby se najednou zpracovaly všechny záznamy ze starého uloženého světa s vypnutým seskupováním.

trans-unit.id: Chunk dimensions of the world along X-Z. Both dimensions must have the same value and be divisible by 4. World size has limits but they usually apply when world size bigger than 250x250. If you want size bigger -> then MaxBuildHeight must be less than 320. Example: Size 300 has 238 max height, 400 has 134, etc.
trans-unit.source: Chunk dimensions of the world along X-Z. Both dimensions must have the same value and be divisible by 4. World size has limits but they usually apply when world size bigger than 250x250. If you want size bigger -> then MaxBuildHeight must be less than 320. Example: Size 300 has 238 max height, 400 has 134, etc.
trans-unit.target: Rozměry světa v chuncích podél os X–Z. Oba rozměry musí mít stejnou hodnotu a být dělitelné 4. Velikost světa má limity, které se obvykle uplatní až u světů větších než 250×250. Pokud chceš větší svět, MaxBuildHeight musí být menší než 320. Příklad: velikost 300 má maximální výšku 238, velikost 400 má 134 atd.

trans-unit.id: Maximum height of the world citizens may build to. Can't be lowered after world creation. Note that values bigger than 160 will heavily increase CPU and RAM resources needed for world. Has hard limit for 320. Should not be lower than MaxGenerationHeight. World dimensions product ((Length * 10) * MaxBuildHeight * (Width * 10)) must be less than max value if INT, so values can be clamped to lower on server start.
trans-unit.source: Maximum height of the world citizens may build to. Can't be lowered after world creation. Note that values bigger than 160 will heavily increase CPU and RAM resources needed for world. Has hard limit for 320. Should not be lower than MaxGenerationHeight. World dimensions product ((Length * 10) * MaxBuildHeight * (Width * 10)) must be less than max value if INT, so values can be clamped to lower on server start.
trans-unit.target: Maximální výška, do které mohou občané ve světě stavět. Po vytvoření světa ji nelze snížit. Hodnoty vyšší než 160 výrazně zvýší nároky světa na procesor a paměť RAM. Pevný limit je 320. Hodnota by neměla být nižší než MaxGenerationHeight. Součin rozměrů světa ((Length * 10) * MaxBuildHeight * (Width * 10)) musí být menší než maximální hodnota typu INT, takže hodnoty mohou být při spuštění serveru sníženy.

trans-unit.id: Specifies the formula or curve that controls the shape of how the audio fades between the ConversationalDistance and the AudibleDistance. (1:InverseByDistance) - Fades voice quickly at first, buts slows down as you get further from conversational distance. (2:LinearByDistance) - Fades voice slowly at first, but speeds up as you get further from conversational distance. (3:ExponentialByDistance) - Voice within conversational distance is louder, but fades quickly beyond it.
trans-unit.source: Specifies the formula or curve that controls the shape of how the audio fades between the ConversationalDistance and the AudibleDistance. (1:InverseByDistance) - Fades voice quickly at first, buts slows down as you get further from conversational distance. (2:LinearByDistance) - Fades voice slowly at first, but speeds up as you get further from conversational distance. (3:ExponentialByDistance) - Voice within conversational distance is louder, but fades quickly beyond it.
trans-unit.target: Určuje vzorec nebo křivku, podle které hlas slábne mezi ConversationalDistance a AudibleDistance. (1:InverseByDistance) – hlas zpočátku slábne rychle, ale s rostoucí vzdáleností od konverzační vzdálenosti se zpomaluje. (2:LinearByDistance) – hlas zpočátku slábne pomalu, ale s rostoucí vzdáleností se zrychluje. (3:ExponentialByDistance) – hlas v konverzační vzdálenosti je hlasitější, ale za ní rychle slábne.

trans-unit.id: Defines how the penalty percentage scales between the start and maximum pollution values. Possible values: Linear (penalty increases uniformly), Exponential (penalty increases slowly at first, then rapidly at high pollution), Logarithmic (penalty is strong at low pollution, then flattens at higher values), DoubleSigmoid (penalty increases strongly at low pollution, slows near mid-range, then increases strongly again near maximum pollution).
trans-unit.source: Defines how the penalty percentage scales between the start and maximum pollution values. Possible values: Linear (penalty increases uniformly), Exponential (penalty increases slowly at first, then rapidly at high pollution), Logarithmic (penalty is strong at low pollution, then flattens at higher values), DoubleSigmoid (penalty increases strongly at low pollution, slows near mid-range, then increases strongly again near maximum pollution).
trans-unit.target: Určuje, jak se procento postihu mění mezi počáteční a maximální hodnotou znečištění. Možné hodnoty (zadávají se anglicky): Linear (postih roste rovnoměrně), Exponential (postih zpočátku roste pomalu, při vysokém znečištění rychle), Logarithmic (postih je silný při nízkém znečištění, při vyšších hodnotách se vyrovnává), DoubleSigmoid (postih silně roste při nízkém znečištění, uprostřed rozsahu se zpomalí a těsně před maximálním znečištěním opět silně roste).

trans-unit.id:
Defines a set of blocks that must exist, or not exist on a property. This can be used for all kinds of things:
 - Removing unwanted plants
 - Removing pollution

If {Text.Info(Surface)} is checked, only surface blocks will be examined. Otherwise, blocks to a depth of {Text.Info(5)} below the highest block will be examined.
trans-unit.source:
Defines a set of blocks that must exist, or not exist on a property. This can be used for all kinds of things:
 - Removing unwanted plants
 - Removing pollution
 - Planting fields (planted blocks must exist)
 - Removing structures or obstacles.

If {Text.Info(Surface)} is checked, only surface blocks will be examined. Otherwise, blocks to a depth of {Text.Info(5)} below the highest block will be examined.
trans-unit.target:
Určuje sadu bloků, které na pozemku musí, nebo nesmí existovat. Využití je různé:

Pokud je zaškrtnuto {Text.Info(Surface)}, zkoumají se jen povrchové bloky. Jinak se zkoumají bloky do hloubky {Text.Info(5)} pod nejvyšším blokem.

trans-unit.id: This clause allows players to define in words what they would like done. When using this clause, the contract can no longer be auto-approved, and the client will have to approve it before accepting it. When accepting a contract with a custom clause, it is wise to first review the reputation of the citizen offering it, because it is fully at their discretion to approve or deny its completion.\n\nYou must uncheck {Text.Info(Auto-Approve)} at the bottom of the contract to use this clause.
trans-unit.source: This clause allows players to define in words what they would like done. When using this clause, the contract can no longer be auto-approved, and the client will have to approve it before accepting it. When accepting a contract with a custom clause, it is wise to first review the reputation of the citizen offering it, because it is fully at their discretion to approve or deny its completion.\n\nYou must uncheck {Text.Info(Auto-Approve)} at the bottom of the contract to use this clause.
trans-unit.target: Tato doložka umožňuje hráčům slovy určit, co chtějí mít uděláno. Při jejím použití už nelze smlouvu schválit automaticky a klient ji bude muset schválit před jejím přijetím. Před přijetím smlouvy s vlastní doložkou je rozumné nejprve zkontrolovat reputaci občana, který ji nabízí, protože jen na jeho uvážení záleží, zda splnění schválí, nebo zamítne.\n\nK použití této doložky musíš dole ve smlouvě zrušit zaškrtnutí políčka {Text.Info(Auto-Approve)}.

trans-unit.id: Defines a container that must contain a set of objects. Both you and the contractor must have access rights on the selected container.\n\nYou can automatically give the contractor access rights to the container for the term of the contract with an additional Permissions contract clause.
trans-unit.source: Defines a container that must contain a set of objects. Both you and the contractor must have access rights on the selected container.\n\nYou can automatically give the contractor access rights to the container for the term of the contract with an additional Permissions contract clause.
trans-unit.target: Určuje kontejner, který musí obsahovat sadu objektů. K vybranému kontejneru musí mít přístupová práva jak ty, tak dodavatel.\n\nDodavateli můžeš na dobu trvání smlouvy automaticky udělit přístupová práva ke kontejneru další smluvní doložkou Oprávnění.

trans-unit.id:
This clause allows you to restrict the acceptance of a contract to only those that have a reputation equal to or greater than the defined amount.

There are two kinds of reputation you can specify here: 
 - Reputation, which is the sum of all player's ratings.
 - Relative Reputation, which is the sum of the opinions from players you have rated favorably (and who they have rated favorably, etc).

You can review the reputations of all players on the server through the citizen list, which displays players in reputation order, and displays reviews from other players in the reputation tooltip.
trans-unit.source:
This clause allows you to restrict the acceptance of a contract to only those that have a reputation equal to or greater than the defined amount.

There are two kinds of reputation you can specify here: 
 - Reputation, which is the sum of all player's ratings.
 - Relative Reputation, which is the sum of the opinions from players you have rated favorably (and who they have rated favorably, etc).

You can review the reputations of all players on the server through the citizen list, which displays players in reputation order, and displays reviews from other players in the reputation tooltip.
trans-unit.target:
Tato doložka umožňuje omezit přijetí smlouvy jen na ty, kdo mají reputaci rovnou zadané hodnotě nebo vyšší.

Zadat lze dva druhy reputace: 
 - Reputace, což je součet hodnocení od všech hráčů.
 - Relativní reputace, což je součet názorů hráčů, kterým dáváš kladné hodnocení (a hráčů, kterým kladné hodnocení dávají oni, atd.).

Reputaci všech hráčů na serveru zjistíš v seznamu občanů, který řadí hráče podle reputace a v popisku reputace ukazuje recenze od ostatních hráčů.

This clause allows you to restrict the acceptance of a contract to only those that have a reputation equal to or greater than the defined amount.

trans-unit.id:
This clause will grant the contractor authorization to the selected object or property. Authorization can be granted temporarily for the length of the contract, or it can be given permanently. This permission can be given at either the beginning or end of the contract.

trans-unit.id:
Enabling VSync tells your graphics card to synchronize its actions with your monitor. That means the graphics card is only allowed to render things to the monitor when the monitor says it is ready to repaint a new screen.
Performance impact: Average

Enabling VSync tells your graphics card to synchronize its actions with your monitor. That means the graphics card is only allowed to render things to the monitor when the monitor says it is ready to repaint a new screen.
Performance impact: Average
trans-unit.target:
Zapnutí VSync říká grafické kartě, aby synchronizovala svou činnost s monitorem. To znamená, že grafická karta smí vykreslovat obraz na monitor jen tehdy, když monitor oznámí, že je připraven překreslit nový snímek.
Vliv na výkon: Průměrný

Propoj se s Twitchem, aby se tví diváci mohli účastnit voleb, prohlížet grafy ekosystému a mnohem víc pomocí našeho vlastního rozšíření ECO.
Po propojení a zapnutí se integrace aktivuje, jakmile se připojíš k serveru Eco s podporou Twitche.

trans-unit.id:
Annexing a target requires paying them Claim Papers from the source settlement. Unlike resources, these 100% go to the foundation of the target without waste. The cost is determined per-non-abandoned citizen in the target.
In the case of annexing a Homestead, this number will be increased by the number of Homestead Support Claim Papers that are on the stake. This makes the support claims not only allow homesteads to claim more plots, but have more protection against annexation.
trans-unit.source:
Annexing a target requires paying them Claim Papers from the source settlement. Unlike resources, these 100% go to the foundation of the target without waste. The cost is determined per-non-abandoned citizen in the target.
In the case of annexing a Homestead, this number will be increased by the number of Homestead Support Claim Papers that are on the stake. This makes the support claims not only allow homesteads to claim more plots, but have more protection against annexation.
trans-unit.target:
Anexe cíle vyžaduje zaplatit mu záborové listiny ze zdrojové osady. Na rozdíl od surovin jdou tyto listiny ze 100 % bez ztrát do objektu založení cíle. Cena se počítá za každého neopuštěného občana v cíli.
Při anexi usedlosti se tento počet zvýší o počet podpůrných záborových listin pro usedlost, které jsou na kolíku. Podpůrné zábory tak usedlostem nejen umožňují zabrat více parcel, ale také je lépe chrání před anexí.

trans-unit.id:
The resources shown must exist in storage attached to an Embassy Desk that is assigned to the Settlement's jurisdiction. They must be accessible to the leader of the Settlement. The cost is determined per-non-abandoned citizen in the target.
Upon annexation, a percent of these will be given to the other party, and the rest destroyed as the cost of the annexation.
If all citizens of a target are 'Abandoned', no resources are needed.
trans-unit.source:
The resources shown must exist in storage attached to an Embassy Desk that is assigned to the Settlement's jurisdiction. They must be accessible to the leader of the Settlement. The cost is determined per-non-abandoned citizen in the target.

If all citizens of a target are 'Abandoned', no resources are needed.
trans-unit.target:
Zobrazené suroviny musí být ve skladu připojeném k velvyslaneckému stolu přiřazenému k jurisdikci osady. Musí být dostupné vedoucímu osady. Cena se počítá za každého neopuštěného občana v cíli.
Po anexi se jejich určité procento předá druhé straně a zbytek se zničí jako cena anexe.
Pokud jsou všichni občané cíle „opuštění“, nejsou potřeba žádné suroviny.

trans-unit.id:
Note that 'Integrity' is not the same as 'Durability'.
Integrity is the max Durability that an object can be repaired to, which drops each time it's repaired. Repairing raises the durability of an item to the current Integrity, but Integrity can never be raised, only lowered.

trans-unit.source: How many citizens holding the dedicated profession are required before an area benefit building applies its bonuses.
trans-unit.target: Kolik občanů s profesí, pro kterou je budova určena, je potřeba, aby budova s plošným bonusem začala uplatňovat své bonusy.

trans-unit.source: If set, area benefit buildings dedicated to a profession only apply their bonuses while enough citizens hold that profession.
trans-unit.target: Je-li zapnuto, budovy s plošným bonusem určené pro některou profesi uplatňují své bonusy, jen dokud tuto profesi má dost občanů.

trans-unit.id: Sets a buffer pollution layer value (soil/heavymineral/chemical) around you.
trans-unit.source: Sets a buffer pollution layer value (soil/heavymineral/chemical) around you.

trans-unit.id: Queues decontamination of a buffer layer (soil/heavymineral/chemical) around you.
trans-unit.source: Queues decontamination of a buffer layer (soil/heavymineral/chemical) around you.

trans-unit.id: Dumps pollution values for the claim you're standing on.
trans-unit.source: Dumps pollution values for the claim you're standing on.
trans-unit.target: Vypíše hodnoty znečištění pro zábor, na kterém stojíš.

trans-unit.id: Clears all pollution layers and the buffer cache (resets the pollution system).
trans-unit.source: Clears all pollution layers and the buffer cache (resets the pollution system).
trans-unit.target: Vymaže všechny vrstvy znečištění i vyrovnávací paměť (resetuje systém znečištění).

trans-unit.id: Organic remediation blend that helps soil recover from light (Trash/sewage) pollution. Apply to a claim to gradually reduce its Soil Pollution over a day.
trans-unit.source: Organic remediation blend that helps soil recover from light (Trash/sewage) pollution. Apply to a claim to gradually reduce its Soil Pollution over a day.

trans-unit.id: Mineral binder that immobilizes heavy-metal contamination. Apply to a claim to reduce its Heavy Mineral Pollution — the only way down once it passes the self-cleaning ceiling.
trans-unit.source: Mineral binder that immobilizes heavy-metal contamination. Apply to a claim to reduce its Heavy Mineral Pollution — the only way down once it passes the self-cleaning ceiling.

trans-unit.id: Industrial reagent that neutralizes toxic chemical contamination. Costly to produce, but the only way to recover land past the chemical self-cleaning ceiling.
trans-unit.source: Industrial reagent that neutralizes toxic chemical contamination. Costly to produce, but the only way to recover land past the chemical self-cleaning ceiling.
trans-unit.target: Průmyslové činidlo, které neutralizuje toxickou chemickou kontaminaci. Je nákladné na výrobu, ale je to jediný způsob, jak obnovit půdu, jejíž chemické znečištění přesáhlo hranici samočištění.

trans-unit.id: A rigid dumpster that can be moved, holds a large amount of garbage and only leaks on wednesdays.
trans-unit.source: A rigid dumpster that can be moved, holds a large amount of garbage and only leaks on wednesdays.
trans-unit.target: Pevný kontejner, který lze přemisťovat, pojme velké množství odpadu a protéká jen ve středy.

trans-unit.id: A rigid dumpster that can be moved, holds a large amount of garbage and only leaks on mondays.
trans-unit.source: A rigid dumpster that can be moved, holds a large amount of garbage and only leaks on mondays.
trans-unit.target: Pevný kontejner, který lze přemisťovat, pojme velké množství odpadu a protéká jen v pondělky.

trans-unit.id: A rigid dumpster that can be moved, holds a large amount of garbage and only leaks on fridays.
trans-unit.source: A rigid dumpster that can be moved, holds a large amount of garbage and only leaks on fridays.
trans-unit.target: Pevný kontejner, který lze přemisťovat, pojme velké množství odpadu a protéká jen v pátky.

trans-unit.id: Water recovered from treating waste effluent. Safe to release back into the environment, but no longer fit to feed machinery — pipe it out to the world.
trans-unit.source: Water recovered from treating waste effluent. Safe to release back into the environment, but no longer fit to feed machinery — pipe it out to the world.

trans-unit.id: A rig that allows a truck to move dumpsters.
trans-unit.source: A rig that allows a truck to move dumpsters.
trans-unit.target: Nástavba, která nákladnímu vozu umožňuje přemisťovat kontejnery.

trans-unit.id: A flatbed for the steam truck.
trans-unit.source: A flatbed for the steam truck.

trans-unit.id: A flatbed for the modern truck.
trans-unit.source: A flatbed for the modern truck.

trans-unit.id: Leftover residue from garbage sorting — compost, inert garbage and pollutants mixed together. Run it through a Residuals Sorter to separate it.
trans-unit.source: Leftover residue from garbage sorting — compost, inert garbage and pollutants mixed together. Run it through a Residuals Sorter to separate it.
trans-unit.target: Zbytky po třídění odpadu – smíchaný kompost, inertní odpad a znečišťující látky. K jejich oddělení je zpracuj ve třídiči zbytkového odpadu.
Zvětšuje velikost tvého inventáře o 10 kg.

trans-unit.id: Increase your stomach capacity count by 2000 calories.
trans-unit.source: Increase your stomach capacity count by 2000 calories.
trans-unit.target: Zvyšuje kapacitu tvého žaludku o 2000 kalorií.

trans-unit.id: Recovered electronic scrap, requires further processing through liquid acids in order to recover minerals.
trans-unit.source: Recovered electronic scrap, requires further processing through liquid acids in order to recover minerals.

trans-unit.id: Can you carry as much as a bear! Not really, but it helps you carry more.\n\n(Increases max carry weight by 15 kg and expands backpackslots by 8)
trans-unit.source: Can you carry as much as a bear! Not really, but it helps you carry more.\n\n(Increases max carry weight by 15 kg and expands backpackslots by 8)

trans-unit.id: A survival backpack that offers more support than the basic backpack.\n\n(Increases max carry weight by 15 kg and expands your backpack slots by 4)
trans-unit.source: A survival backpack that offers more support than the basic backpack.\n\n(Increases max carry weight by 15 kg and expands your backpack slots by 4)

trans-unit.id: It just looks cool.\n\n(Increases movement speed and decreases calories consumed when using tools by 20% but reduces your backpack slots by 8)
trans-unit.source: It just looks cool.\n\n(Increases movement speed and decreases calories consumed when using tools by 20% but reduces your backpack slots by 8)

trans-unit.id: Smaller than your standard three-day backpack. You can't fit that much inside, but that makes you more agile.\n\n(Increases movement speed and increases max carry weight by 8 kg but reduces backpack slots by 4)
trans-unit.source: Smaller than your standard three-day backpack. You can't fit that much inside, but that makes you more agile.\n\n(Increases movement speed and increases max carry weight by 8 kg but reduces backpack slots by 4)

trans-unit.id: Lighter pack that increases your carry slots.\n\n and increases max carry weight by 8 kg)
trans-unit.source: Lighter pack that increases your carry slots.\n\n and increases max carry weight by 8 kg)

trans-unit.id: This is a deprecated item that will be removed in a future update.
trans-unit.source: This is a deprecated item that will be removed in a future update.
trans-unit.target: Tento předmět je zastaralý a bude v budoucí aktualizaci odstraněn.

trans-unit.id: A specialized sorting unit that processes biological waste materials, including food matter and fabrics. By analyzing material composition, it separates organic material for composting from reusable textile fibers for recovery and recycling.
trans-unit.source: A specialized sorting unit that processes biological waste materials, including food matter and fabrics. By analyzing material composition, it separates organic material for composting from reusable textile fibers for recovery and recycling.
trans-unit.target: Specializovaná třídicí jednotka, která zpracovává biologický odpad včetně zbytků jídla a tkanin. Na základě analýzy složení materiálu odděluje organický materiál ke kompostování od znovu použitelných textilních vláken, která se získávají zpět a recyklují.

trans-unit.id: A bulk material sorting system designed for construction and demolition waste. Through a series of graded mesh screens, it separates mixed debris into glass fragments, ceramic waste, and stone rubble for specialized recycling.
trans-unit.source: A bulk material sorting system designed for construction and demolition waste. Through a series of graded mesh screens, it separates mixed debris into glass fragments, ceramic waste, and stone rubble for specialized recycling.
trans-unit.target: Systém pro třídění sypkých materiálů určený pro stavební a demoliční odpad. Řadou sít s odstupňovanou velikostí ok rozděluje smíšenou suť na skleněné střepy, keramické střepy a kamennou suť pro specializovanou recyklaci.

trans-unit.id: A mechanical sorting system that processes mixed garbage and separates it into primary recycling types. Materials are categorized according to the fractioanl composition of the incoming waste, producing Mixed blocks of varies types, Bio Residue, Metal Scrap, Construction Scrap and Industrial Waste.
trans-unit.source: A mechanical sorting system that processes mixed garbage and separates it into primary recycling types. Materials are categorized according to the fractioanl composition of the incoming waste, producing Mixed blocks of varies types, Bio Residue, Metal Scrap, Construction Scrap and Industrial Waste.
trans-unit.target: Mechanický třídicí systém, který zpracovává smíšený odpad a rozděluje ho na hlavní druhy k recyklaci. Materiály se zařazují podle zlomkového složení přijímaného odpadu a vznikají smíšené bloky různých druhů, biologický odpad, kovový šrot, stavební suť a průmyslový odpad.

trans-unit.id: A multi-stage recycling system that handles complex industrial waste streams. Combining electricity separation, carbon processing, and mesh filtration, it extracts electronic waste, plastics, and hazardous pollutants into distinct categories for treatment and recovery.
trans-unit.source: A multi-stage recycling system that handles complex industrial waste streams. Combining electricity separation, carbon processing, and mesh filtration, it extracts electronic waste, plastics, and hazardous pollutants into distinct categories for treatment and recovery.
trans-unit.target: Vícestupňový recyklační systém pro složité proudy průmyslového odpadu. Kombinací elektrického oddělování, uhlíkového zpracování a sítové filtrace vytřídí elektronický odpad, plasty a nebezpečné znečišťující látky do samostatných kategorií pro další zpracování a zpětné získání.

trans-unit.id: An advanced metal recovery system that processes mixed metallic scrap. Using a combination of magnetic separation and chemical extraction, it isolates iron, copper, and gold into individual blocks for recycling.
trans-unit.source: An advanced metal recovery system that processes mixed metallic scrap. Using a combination of magnetic separation and chemical extraction, it isolates iron, copper, and gold into individual blocks for recycling.
trans-unit.target: Pokročilý systém pro zpětné získávání kovů, který zpracovává smíšený kovový šrot. Kombinací magnetického oddělování a chemické extrakce izoluje železo, měď a zlato do samostatných bloků k recyklaci.

trans-unit.id: A basic container to put garbage into, should probably replace it when you can. Better than a stockpile but still contaminates surroundings.
trans-unit.source: A basic container to put garbage into, should probably replace it when you can. Better than a stockpile but still contaminates surroundings.
trans-unit.target: Základní nádoba na odpad, kterou je dobré při první příležitosti vyměnit. Je lepší než sklad, ale okolí stále kontaminuje.

trans-unit.id: A specialized machine that separates mixed residuals into compost, garbage and concentrated pollutants for disposal or decontamination.
trans-unit.source: A specialized machine that separates mixed residuals into compost, garbage and concentrated pollutants for disposal or decontamination.
trans-unit.target: Specializovaný stroj, který rozděluje smíšené zbytky na kompost, odpad a koncentrované znečišťující látky k likvidaci nebo dekontaminaci.

trans-unit.id: A classic bin for all your disposal needs.
trans-unit.source: A classic bin for all your disposal needs.
trans-unit.target: Klasická popelnice na všechno, co je třeba vyhodit.

trans-unit.id: A storage tank for liquids allowing for a more reliable buffer.
trans-unit.source: A storage tank for liquids allowing for a more reliable buffer.
trans-unit.target: Nádrž na kapaliny, která umožňuje spolehlivější vyrovnávací zásobu.

trans-unit.id: Uses a carbon filter to scrub pollutants (fresh or salt), returning clean water to the output pipe and dropping the captured organic residue into a linked inventory as compost / bio-residue blocks.
trans-unit.source: Uses a carbon filter to scrub pollutants (fresh or salt), returning clean water to the output pipe and dropping the captured organic residue into a linked inventory as compost / bio-residue blocks.
trans-unit.target: Pomocí uhlíkového filtru zbavuje vodu (sladkou i slanou) znečišťujících látek, čistou vodu vypouští výstupní trubkou a zachycené organické zbytky ukládá do propojeného inventáře jako bloky kompostu nebo biologického odpadu.

trans-unit.id: A larger storage for garbage but is not entirely secure.
trans-unit.source: A larger storage for garbage but is not entirely secure.
trans-unit.target: Větší sklad na odpad, který však není úplně zabezpečený.

trans-unit.id: Maximum number of dinner parties that can be started on a single claim (deed) per day. Set to 0 or less for no limit.
trans-unit.source: Maximum number of dinner parties that can be started on a single claim (deed) per day. Set to 0 or less for no limit.
trans-unit.target: Maximální počet hostin, které lze za den zahájit na jednom záboru (listu vlastnictví). Při hodnotě 0 nebo méně není počet omezen.

trans-unit.id: Maximum number of dinner parties that can be started within a single settlement per day. Set to 0 or less for no limit.
trans-unit.source: Maximum number of dinner parties that can be started within a single settlement per day. Set to 0 or less for no limit.
trans-unit.target: Maximální počet hostin, které lze za den zahájit v rámci jedné osady. Při hodnotě 0 nebo méně není počet omezen.

trans-unit.id: Maximum number of dinner parties a single player can participate in per day. Set to 0 or less for no limit.
trans-unit.source: Maximum number of dinner parties a single player can participate in per day. Set to 0 or less for no limit.
trans-unit.target: Maximální počet hostin, kterých se může jeden hráč za den zúčastnit. Při hodnotě 0 nebo méně není počet omezen.

trans-unit.id: Average ground pollution value at which the penalty reaches its maximum. Pollution above this value does not increase the penalty further. GroundPollution is capped at 1, so the penalty maxes out at full pollution.
trans-unit.source: Average ground pollution value at which the penalty reaches its maximum. Pollution above this value does not increase the penalty further. GroundPollution is capped at 1, so the penalty maxes out at full pollution.
trans-unit.target: Průměrná hodnota znečištění země, při které postih dosáhne maxima. Vyšší znečištění už postih dále nezvyšuje. Hodnota GroundPollution je omezena shora číslem 1, takže postih dosáhne maxima při plném znečištění.

trans-unit.id: Pass fluid through when out of catalyst
trans-unit.source: Pass fluid through when out of catalyst

trans-unit.id: What to do when this filter runs out of catalyst. ON: let the incoming fluid pass straight through unfiltered (keeps the line flowing, but it isn't cleaned). OFF: stop and hold the fluid back until catalyst is restocked.
trans-unit.source: What to do when this filter runs out of catalyst. ON: let the incoming fluid pass straight through unfiltered (keeps the line flowing, but it isn't cleaned). OFF: stop and hold the fluid back until catalyst is restocked.
trans-unit.target: Co dělat, když filtru dojde katalyzátor. ZAPNUTO: příchozí kapalina projde rovnou bez filtrace (potrubí zůstane průtočné, ale kapalina se nečistí). VYPNUTO: filtr se zastaví a kapalinu zadrží, dokud se katalyzátor nedoplní.

trans-unit.id: Allow stored fluid to drain out the output. Off (default): the tank holds everything. On: it drains at the full rate — out the connected pipe, or spilled onto the ground (which may pollute) if the output isn't piped to anything.
trans-unit.source: Allow stored fluid to drain out the output. Off (default): the tank holds everything. On: it drains at the full rate — out the connected pipe, or spilled onto the ground (which may pollute) if the output isn't piped to anything.
trans-unit.target: Povolí odtok uložené kapaliny výstupem. Vypnuto (výchozí): nádrž si všechno drží. Zapnuto: kapalina odtéká plnou rychlostí – připojenou trubkou, nebo se vylévá na zem (což může znečišťovat), pokud výstup nikam nevede.

trans-unit.id: A citizen produced garbage as a byproduct of crafting.
trans-unit.source: A citizen produced garbage as a byproduct of crafting.
trans-unit.target: Občan vyprodukoval odpad jako vedlejší produkt výroby.

trans-unit.id: The profession this building's bonuses apply to.
trans-unit.source: The profession this building's bonuses apply to.
trans-unit.target: Profese, na kterou se vztahují bonusy této budovy.

trans-unit.id: Invest a star to help activate this building's benefits.
trans-unit.source: Invest a star to help activate this building's benefits.
trans-unit.target: Investuj hvězdu a pomoz aktivovat výhody této budovy.

trans-unit.id: The ground pollution density (0-1) at or above which the plant cannot reproduce and has zero yield. Between PollutionDensityTolerance and this value, yield falls off linearly.
trans-unit.source: The ground pollution density (0-1) at or above which the plant cannot reproduce and has zero yield. Between PollutionDensityTolerance and this value, yield falls off linearly.
trans-unit.target: Hustota znečištění země (0–1), při které a nad kterou se rostlina nemůže rozmnožovat a nemá žádný výnos. Mezi hodnotou PollutionDensityTolerance a touto hodnotou výnos klesá lineárně.

trans-unit.id: The ground pollution density (0-1) up to which the plant is unaffected. Effects begin above this value. GroundPollution is now capped at 1, so this reads directly as a percentage.
trans-unit.source: The ground pollution density (0-1) up to which the plant is unaffected. Effects begin above this value. GroundPollution is now capped at 1, so this reads directly as a percentage.
trans-unit.target: Hustota znečištění země (0–1), do které rostlinu znečištění neovlivňuje. Účinky začínají nad touto hodnotou. Hodnota GroundPollution je nyní omezena shora číslem 1, takže se hodnota čte přímo jako procenta.

trans-unit.id: Number of in-game days the buffer pollution layers take to converge toward their target value (and to decay back down).
trans-unit.source: Number of in-game days the buffer pollution layers take to converge toward their target value (and to decay back down).
trans-unit.target: Počet herních dní, za které se vyrovnávací vrstvy znečištění přiblíží cílové hodnotě (a za které zase klesnou zpět).

trans-unit.id: In-game days that freshly produced waste is held pollution-free before it starts polluting the ground once stored. Waste that wasn't produced (dumped blocks, etc.) pollutes immediately.
trans-unit.source: In-game days that freshly produced waste is held pollution-free before it starts polluting the ground once stored. Waste that wasn't produced (dumped blocks, etc.) pollutes immediately.
trans-unit.target: Počet herních dní, po které se čerstvě vyprodukovaný odpad drží bez znečišťování, než začne po uložení znečišťovat zem. Odpad, který nevznikl výrobou (vysypané bloky apod.), znečišťuje okamžitě.

trans-unit.id: Heavy mineral pollution stops decaying naturally once a claim's value rises above this. Only active decontamination can bring it back down past this point.
trans-unit.source: Heavy mineral pollution stops decaying naturally once a claim's value rises above this. Only active decontamination can bring it back down past this point.
trans-unit.target: Znečištění těžkými minerály přestane přirozeně ubývat, jakmile hodnota na záboru překročí tuto hranici. Pod ni ho dokáže vrátit jen aktivní dekontaminace.

trans-unit.id: Chemical pollution stops decaying naturally once a claim's value rises above this. Only active decontamination can bring it back down past this point.
trans-unit.source: Chemical pollution stops decaying naturally once a claim's value rises above this. Only active decontamination can bring it back down past this point.
trans-unit.target: Chemické znečištění přestane přirozeně ubývat, jakmile hodnota na záboru překročí tuto hranici. Pod ni ho dokáže vrátit jen aktivní dekontaminace.

trans-unit.id: Contribution of the Soil Pollution buffer to ground pollution (ground = sum of each buffer × its ratio).
trans-unit.source: Contribution of the Soil Pollution buffer to ground pollution (ground = sum of each buffer × its ratio).
trans-unit.target: Podíl vyrovnávací vrstvy znečištění půdy na znečištění země (znečištění země = součet všech vyrovnávacích vrstev × jejich poměr).

trans-unit.id: Contribution of the Heavy Mineral Pollution buffer to ground pollution (ground = sum of each buffer × its ratio).
trans-unit.source: Contribution of the Heavy Mineral Pollution buffer to ground pollution (ground = sum of each buffer × its ratio).
trans-unit.target: Podíl vyrovnávací vrstvy znečištění těžkými minerály na znečištění země (znečištění země = součet všech vyrovnávacích vrstev × jejich poměr).

trans-unit.id: Contribution of the Chemical Pollution buffer to ground pollution (ground = sum of each buffer × its ratio).
trans-unit.source: Contribution of the Chemical Pollution buffer to ground pollution (ground = sum of each buffer × its ratio).
trans-unit.target: Podíl vyrovnávací vrstvy chemického znečištění na znečištění země (znečištění země = součet všech vyrovnávacích vrstev × jejich poměr).

trans-unit.id: Contribution of the Acid Rain Pollution buffer to ground pollution (ground = sum of each buffer × its ratio).
trans-unit.source: Contribution of the Acid Rain Pollution buffer to ground pollution (ground = sum of each buffer × its ratio).
trans-unit.target: Podíl vyrovnávací vrstvy znečištění kyselým deštěm na znečištění země (znečištění země = součet všech vyrovnávacích vrstev × jejich poměr).

trans-unit.source: Sent {0} private messages to you from {1} test users.
trans-unit.target: Soukromé zprávy ti poslali testovací uživatelé. Zpráv: {0}, uživatelů: {1}.

trans-unit.source: The garbage collector isn't responding — try re-attaching the module.

trans-unit.source: The dumpster loader isn't responding — try re-attaching the module.

trans-unit.source: Recycles a full garbage block every {0} seconds, with {1} efficiency. Accepts only items with a {2}.

trans-unit.id: Organic remediation blend that helps soil recover from light (Trash/sewage) pollution. Apply it to any ground or built block on a claim: one unit cancels one unit of Soil Pollution source, and half of the decontaminant waiting on an area takes effect every 24 hours.
trans-unit.source: Organic remediation blend that helps soil recover from light (Trash/sewage) pollution. Apply it to any ground or built block on a claim: one unit cancels one unit of Soil Pollution source, and half of the decontaminant waiting on an area takes effect every 24 hours.
trans-unit.target: Organická směs, která pomáhá půdě zotavit se z lehkého znečištění (odpadky a odpadní voda). Aplikuj ji na jakýkoli blok terénu nebo stavby na záboru: jedna jednotka zruší jednu jednotku zdroje znečištění půdy a každých 24 hodin se uplatní polovina dekontaminantu čekajícího na dané oblasti.

trans-unit.id: Mineral binder that immobilizes heavy-metal contamination ? the only way down once a claim passes the self-cleaning ceiling. Apply it to any ground or built block on a claim: one unit cancels one unit of Heavy Mineral Pollution source, and half of the decontaminant waiting on an area takes effect every 24 hours.
trans-unit.source: Mineral binder that immobilizes heavy-metal contamination ? the only way down once a claim passes the self-cleaning ceiling. Apply it to any ground or built block on a claim: one unit cancels one unit of Heavy Mineral Pollution source, and half of the decontaminant waiting on an area takes effect every 24 hours.
trans-unit.target: Minerální pojivo, které znehybňuje kontaminaci těžkými kovy – jediný způsob, jak znečištění snížit, jakmile zábor překročí strop samočištění. Aplikuj ho na jakýkoli blok terénu nebo stavby na záboru: jedna jednotka zruší jednu jednotku zdroje znečištění těžkými minerály a každých 24 hodin se uplatní polovina dekontaminantu čekajícího na dané oblasti.

trans-unit.id: Industrial reagent that neutralizes toxic chemical contamination. Costly to produce, but the only way to recover land past the chemical self-cleaning ceiling. Apply it to any ground or built block on a claim: one unit cancels one unit of Chemical Pollution source, and half of the decontaminant waiting on an area takes effect every 24 hours.
trans-unit.source: Industrial reagent that neutralizes toxic chemical contamination. Costly to produce, but the only way to recover land past the chemical self-cleaning ceiling. Apply it to any ground or built block on a claim: one unit cancels one unit of Chemical Pollution source, and half of the decontaminant waiting on an area takes effect every 24 hours.
trans-unit.target: Průmyslové činidlo neutralizující toxickou chemickou kontaminaci. Je nákladné na výrobu, ale je to jediný způsob, jak obnovit půdu za stropem chemického samočištění. Aplikuj ho na jakýkoli blok terénu nebo stavby na záboru: jedna jednotka zruší jednu jednotku zdroje chemického znečištění a každých 24 hodin se uplatní polovina dekontaminantu čekajícího na dané oblasti.

trans-unit.id: EXPERIMENTAL. Use server garbage collection: much better multi-core utilization at the cost of higher memory usage. If your server hangs at boot and doesn't initialize or you notice other issues, try to turn this setting off first. Not recommended when several servers share one machine. The -servergc=true/false launch argument overrides this. Takes effect after server restart.
trans-unit.source: EXPERIMENTAL. Use server garbage collection: much better multi-core utilization at the cost of higher memory usage. If your server hangs at boot and doesn't initialize or you notice other issues, try to turn this setting off first. Not recommended when several servers share one machine. The -servergc=true/false launch argument overrides this. Takes effect after server restart.
trans-unit.target: EXPERIMENTÁLNÍ. Používá serverový režim garbage collection (úklid paměti): mnohem lepší využití více jader za cenu vyšší spotřeby paměti. Pokud se server při spuštění zasekne a neinicializuje se, nebo si všimneš jiných problémů, zkus nejprve toto nastavení vypnout. Nedoporučuje se, když si jeden počítač sdílí několik serverů. Spouštěcí argument -servergc=true/false toto nastavení přebíjí. Projeví se po restartu serveru.

trans-unit.id: EXPERIMENTAL. Raise the minimum thread pool size so bursts of parallel work are not throttled while the pool grows. If your server hangs at boot and doesn't initialize or you notice other issues, try to turn this setting off first. Not recommended when several servers share one machine. The -threadboost=true/false launch argument overrides this. Takes effect after server restart.
trans-unit.source: EXPERIMENTAL. Raise the minimum thread pool size so bursts of parallel work are not throttled while the pool grows. trans-unit.target: EXPERIMENTÁLNÍ. Zvýší minimální velikost fondu vláken, aby se nárazy paralelní práce neomezovaly, dokud fond roste. Spouštěcí argument -threadboost=true/false toto nastavení přebíjí. Projeví se po restartu serveru.
